title: BankPaymentResult
description: POST from bank-sim to wallet-service with the final result of a payment. Delivered at least once with an identical body; deduplicate by reference.

x-headers.X-Bank-Timestamp: Unix seconds when this attempt was signed
x-headers.X-Bank-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<X-Bank-Timestamp>.<raw body>" with the shared secret>

reference.description: bank-sim payment reference, equals the deposit's gatewayReference

walletDepositId.description: Echo of the id wallet-service sent with the payment

occurredAt.description: When this attempt was sent, not when the payment settled
